entries.candidate: QTS Blakely / Early County, Georgia data center campus (Project Blue Hole)
entries.reason: QTS's dated release (13 August 2026, captured from q.com) announces a community investment agreement with the City of Blakely and Early County for a proposed data center campus in the City of Blakely, which would support announced status. No locator: QTS's Blakely page publishes no map point, address or parcel; Early County parcel search (qPublic) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; www.cityofblakely.com disallows all robots; earlycounty.org exposes no zoning or commission records; the Georgia DCA DRI site disallows robots. Press reports place the site on a privately owned holding of more than 2,000 acres near Early County Airport, which is too broad for a project locator.
entries.reopen_condition: A City of Blakely, Early County or Development Authority record (rezoning, annexation, development agreement or DRI) naming the campus parcels or address, or an accessible official parcel layer; the 13 August observation stays inside the lane's 85-day window until 2026-11-06.
